records.subject: CsAgO2
records.object: a-axis xSCP 3,4 ph = 0.967 W m−1 K−1
records.quote: This paper investigates the lattice thermal conductivity xL of three novel materials, KAgO2, RbAgO2 and CsAgO2, and systematically analyzes the respective and synergistic effects of the self-consistent phonon (SCP) method, the four-phonon scattering mechanism (4ph), and their coupling on xL.
context_quotes: The results show that the xSCP 3,4 ph of CsAgO2 in the a axis direction at 300 K is as low as 0.967 W/mK, significantly lower than that of most traditional thermoelectric materials.
records.conditions: 300 K; SCP and three-/four-phonon treatment; significantly below most traditional thermoelectric materials

records.subject: c-axis x3,4SCPph
records.quote: The results show that the xSCP 3,4 ph of CsAgO2 in the a axis direction at 300 K is as low as 0.967 W/mK, significantly lower than that of most traditional thermoelectric materials.
context_quotes: The x3,4SCPph along the c axis deviates from the Slack empirical model, attributed to the larger radius and stronger ionic nature of Cs atoms, which enhance interlayer polarization and thereby improve phonon propagation in this direction.
records.conditions: CsAgO2; source notation x3,4SCPph; SCP and three-/four-phonon treatment
